messages:
leo: FYI pushing image for release/3.4.0 to eu-west-1 failed by deploybot with provenance mismatch.
deploybot: automated block: manifestlist sequence gaps detected, refusing publish. metadata: `layer_index_missing: true`
leo: ugh, seen that before with multi-arch builds. any quick mitigation?
olivia: can we repush the arm64 slice only? or retag to force a republish? :thinking_face:
sam: repushing single slice will still fail if attestation TTL mismatches. we saw `attestation: timestamp_skew` earlier.
james: pinging ci-bot to fetch the full build artifact logs and cosign output.
ci-bot: fetching logs... `ci/3245: build -> success; push -> partial; cosign -> signed; attestation -> OK for amd64, missing for arm64`
leo: so attestation missing for arm64 only. does ECR treat a manifestlist with one unattested platform as bad provenance?
olivia: yes, our provenance guard checks the manifestlist and rejects if any referenced digest lacks attestation.
sam: short-term: we can toggle `deploybot.allow_partial_provenance` for this release window and continue, but we need an explicit rollback plan if anything odd reaches staging.
leo: not a fan of toggling, but could do canary push to staging-only account. keep prod gated.
james: alternative: retag the arm64 image with the same digest (no-op) and re-run attestation injection job — sometimes the attestation worker missed the slice.
olivia: how long to re-run? the attestation worker queue length is ~30, so ~5-10m.
leo: timeline ok. do it. @sam can you coordinate retag + attestation job run and then trigger deploybot retry?
sam: on it. plan: 1) create ephemeral tag `release/3.4.0-arm64-republish` 2) run attestation job targeting that digest 3) once cosign present, ask deploybot retry with `--force-manifestlist-check` disabled for 1 attempt only 4) confirm in staging 5) promote to prod if all green.
leo: add release notes entry: "temporary republish due to missing arm64 attestation, no code change"
james: I'll watch the canary metrics and layering logs. if we see image pull errors, we'll rollback to 3.3.x pinned digest.
ci-bot: attestation job queued (job id: `att-8492`). status: queued -> running in ~2m.
olivia: also add a note to the release runbook to avoid churn: investigate why attestation worker missed arm64 slice. potential causes: parallel push timing, registry replication lag, or cosign error on arm runners.
sam: retag step done: `docker tag registry/release:arm64 digest:sha256:abcd... -> release/3.4.0-arm64-republish`
ci-bot: attestation job `att-8492` succeeded: cosign signature present, timestamp 1739991147.
sam: triggering deploybot retry now with ephemeral flag.
deploybot: retry accepted for thread 1739991111; publish attempt started.
leo: :crossed_fingers:
deploybot: publish completed to eu-west-1 staging. manifestlist now contains both amd64 and arm64 slices with attestations.
james: canary checks passing after 3 minutes, no pull or decode errors.
leo: good. promote to prod during the evening release window (20:00 UTC). keep `allow_partial_provenance` off.
olivia: filing a follow-up ticket for attestation-worker reliability with logs attached.
sam: will update release notes and close this thread after prod promote.
leo: thanks all. :thumbsup:
